verdict.rationale: a-Shell documents itself as a local Unix-like terminal on iOS that includes the ios_system command set. `help -l | grep` shows grep is available, and the docs describe file operations such as creating directories, moving files and compressing/uncompressing them. However, most of the specific commands the story names are never explicitly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that ls, cat, tar and curl ship and work, and independent or hands-on corroboration of running these commands in the app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run local UNIX commands like ls, grep, cat, tar, and curl directly in the app

citations.quote: The goal in this project is to provide a simple Unix-like terminal on iOS.
It uses ios_system for command interpretation, and includes all commands from the ios_system ecosystem (nslookup, whois, python3, lua, pdflatex, lualatex...)
`help -l | grep command` will tell you if your favorite command is already installed.
Create directories, move files, compress them, uncompress them, edit them, run python, lua or Tex on your files, move them to other apps.
